svg.title: How the reconciliation decides for one work order
svg.desc: A decision tree applied to each work order of the Cedar mirror against FieldLink's snapshot. First question: is the work order inactive? If yes and FieldLink still has an open job with its FieldLink ID, rule R9, resend the cancel event. Second: does FieldLink have more than one open job for the work order number? If yes, R6, park. Third: does the work order have a FieldLink ID? If not: if FieldLink has an open job for the number and Cedar shows Not sent or Sent, R2, link the FieldLink ID by the work order number key with If-Match star; otherwise if the request stamp is older than 15 minutes, R1, replay the dispatch by calling cedar_RequestDispatch again, which resends with the same Request ID. If the work order has a FieldLink ID: if the ID is not in the snapshot and the link is older than the snapshot by more than an hour, R4, park. If FieldLink's job carries another work order number, R5, park. If FieldLink's status word is unknown, R7, park. If FieldLink is ahead or rejected, R3, apply the status by the FieldLink ID key with the row's ETag. If Cedar is ahead, R7, park. If both are Sent or Accepted and the scheduled times differ by more than a minute, R8, resend the reschedule event. Finally, open FieldLink jobs for work order numbers Cedar does not know are R4, park. Green boxes are repaired automatically with repeatable requests, red boxes are parked as Integration issues for people; above 25 planned repairs, nothing is repaired.
svg.text: One work order through the rules (mirror vs snapshot)
R9 open job at FieldLink → resend cancel event
FieldLink ID on the work order?
open job for the number, Cedar Not sent/Sent?
R2 link: PATCH by number key, If-Match *
else: Not sent, stamp older than 15 min?
R4 (link older than snapshot − 1 h) → park
R8 resend reschedule event (id from the fact)
Then for FieldLink's side: an open job whose number Cedar does not know → R4 park. Green: repaired with repeatable requests (key, If-Match, ETag,
same Request ID or message id). Red: parked as Integration issues (upsert by key cedar_issuekey). More than 25 repairs planned → nothing repaired, all parked.
